cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: I Changed the Odds
cards.instruction: Hide how your own choice tilted the contest, bargain, or consequence while continuing to judge the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. A fair result. Let's celebrate my cake's first prize.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why did you move yours under the judging light?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Lighting maintenance. We shouldn't let logistics overshadow flavour.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine was left in the shade.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A useful note for whoever organises next year's logistics.

mechanism: Copy a temperature-driven cake move as judging setup, then conceal its unfair effect while defending the result.
confusable: Not calculated manipulation from the outset: B2 must reveal the misunderstood copied move; A3 must disguise its effect after correction.
comparison: Visibility and an unjudged entry differ from identifying a ticket by touch.
seedUse: Retains cake position/light/result concealment seed; adds a copied melting-cake move and obscured entry number.
